Messages.Author: Martin Bergstrom
Messages.Body:
The group I usually play with play that a minion can take several actions
in a turn as long as it untaps somehow between them. Yesterday I played with
a group that interpreted the rules differently though. The only allow ONE
action per minion even if it untaps. They base this on the paragraph in the
rulebook that say that each minion may take one action per turn. What is the
offical way to play this?

Thanks in advance,
Martin

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mart...@Minsk.DoCS.UU.SE (Martin Bergstrom) writes:



An untapped minion may take an action during its controller's minion
phase, regardless of having previously taken an action. A tapped
minion in torpor could take a "Movement of the Slow Body" action on
the same turn that it had taken another action (which landed it in torpor).

And, a tapped minion may take a "Force of Will" action - which is actually
two actions, after being tapped (from taking an earlier action, for
instance)
